summary: In August 1994, a mysterious, translucent gelatinous substance rained down on the small town of Oakville, Washington, multiple times over a three-week period. Residents and animals fell mysteriously ill after coming into contact with the blobs. Laboratory analyses revealed the presence of human white blood cells and harmful bacteria inside the substance, but key samples mysteriously vanished from state laboratories before conclusive origins could be established.
research_points: Initial reports of gelatinous rain falling over Oakville in August 1994 and the immediate flu-like symptoms reported by local residents.
Laboratory analysis conducted by the Washington State Department of Ecology confirming intact cell structures and bacterial organisms within the jelly.
The severe illness and unexplained deaths of local pets and livestock following direct exposure to the substance.
The unexplained disappearance of official sample vials and research documentation from state health facilities.
Competing theories ranging from secret military biological testing to atmospheric anomalies and micro-organism transportation.
title: Gökyüzünden Yağan Gizemli Jöle: 1994 Oakville Olayı
description: 1994 yılında Washington'ın Oakville kasabasına günlerce ne olduğu belirlenemeyen yapışkan bir madde yağdı. Temas eden onlarca kişi ve hayvan ağır şekilde hastalandı. Laboratuvar analizleri maddenin canlı hücreler barındırdığını gösterdi, ancak numuneler devlet tesislerinden sırra kadem bastı. Shadow Archive ekibi olarak, bilimin açıklayamadığı bu ürpertici olayın arşiv kayıtlarını inceledik.
